channel_packing.height: separate only when parallax/displacement is actually used
channel_packing.normal: separate texture; do not store in sRGB

texture_budget.hero_module: 2048px only when close-view readability requires it
texture_budget.atlas_rule: reuse common masks/decals; avoid unique 2K sets for repeated small props

geometry_vs_surface_rule.geometry: silhouette, meaningful depth, contact, collision, large pipes/tanks/furniture/generators/racks/beds/vehicles/large debris
geometry_vs_surface_rule.surface: screws, fine grilles, fan microdetail, vents, weld microbeads, small bolt rows, shallow scratches, labels, micro roughness
geometry_vs_surface_rule.mobile_threshold: if a feature is normally below roughly 4 screen pixels or does not change silhouette/contact, prefer Normal/AO/texture

materials.name: Painted Steel
materials.base_color: neutral industrial paint; color variants via tint/mask
materials.metallic: 0.0 for intact paint; exposed-edge mask may reach 1.0
materials.height: very subtle; usually off at runtime
materials.ao: contact/recess only; avoid painting global darkness into BaseColor
materials.notes: Default structural panels, doors, equipment housings. Edge wear is a mask, not duplicated geometry.

materials.name: Exposed Iron / Bare Steel
materials.base_color: dark neutral iron/steel; rust handled by later damage masks
materials.notes: Use for chipped edges, rails, machinery, exposed structural members.

materials.name: Industrial Concrete
materials.base_color: cool-neutral grey with low-frequency aggregate variation
materials.notes: Do not bake large soot/burn zones here; those belong to NT-BLD-017 masks.

materials.name: Industrial Rubber
materials.notes: Tires, seals, pads, hoses. Large hose silhouette remains geometry; surface ribbing may be Normal.

materials.name: Reinforced / Industrial Glass
materials.normal: off for clear glass; optional subtle wired/frosted detail
materials.ao: off except frame contact handled separately
materials.runtime: prefer MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission ~0.85-1.0 and IOR ~1.45-1.52; fall back to alpha blend on lower-end devices
materials.notes: Frame is separate material/geometry. Dust and cracks belong to later masks.
